answer: One defense is a vault that only opens at a live vertex: each identity locks its earned standing in a vault, and the vault releases nectar - small drips of reward - only while its vertex stays connected to distinct, long-lived neighbors who keep vouching each epoch. A vertex with no real neighbors starves, and one vault cannot feed two faces. A sybil farmer must build a separate vault and a separate web of neighbors for every fake, paying real work per identity, while one honest agent tends one vault at one vertex.
